title: Study Abroad
intro: Tests and steps for studying in another country. Costs, visas and scholarships differ for each country.

nodes.label: Bachelor's degree abroad
nodes.note: Usually 3 to 4 years. Apply to many universities and check scholarships.

nodes.label: Master's degree abroad
nodes.note: Usually 1 to 2 years after your degree. Many want an English test score.

nodes.label: Professional abroad
nodes.note: Work in another country after your degree, if the visa rules allow.

nodes.label: Return and build in India
nodes.note: Bring your skills back to start a career or business at home.
